messages:
Sasha: Quick heads-up  Sunburst wants a perf validation 08:15 PT tomorrow. Goal: realistic mixed workload, sustained 850 qps, 30m soak. Mix: 65% embeddings (batched), 35% chat (avg ctx ~2048 tokens). SLO: chat p95 < 210ms, p99 < 480ms. They require customer CMK envelope encryption and unwrap audit. Need: short run plan, ops flags, and a rough cost delta. Can @Diego own infra and @Priya run harness?

Diego: Recommend Dedicated pool in us-west-2, pinned nodes. With ctx ~2048 and that qps expect 5-7 GPU-equivalents depending on quant. Enable prefix + KV caching and aggressive embed batching at gateway. I'll provision KMS-proxy in the POC VPC to stabilize unwrap latency.

Priya: I can run the harness. Phases: smoke (4m @75 qps), step-ramp (15m to 850), soak (30m), cooldown (6m). Metrics: p50/p95/p99 per phase, embed TPS, embed batch size distribution, kv hit rate, queue depth. Load config I'll use: ```json
{"target_qps":850,"ramp_mins":15,"soak_mins":30,"mix":[{"type":"embed","pct":65,"batch_max":48},{"type":"chat","pct":35,"ctx_tokens":2048}],"metrics":["p50","p95","p99","embed_tps","kv_hit_rate"]}
```

Alex: Ops flags to include: model_batch_size=10 (large ctx), token_budget_ms=220, kv_cache_ttl=12h, prefix_cache_eviction=15000, embed_batching=true, embed_max_batch=48, trace_sample=0.05. Fallback: if p95 > 300ms or queue_growth>250ms for >30s, divert embeds to quantized-embed-v1 and reduce chat max_tokens to cap tail. Set request_timeout=35s and retry=1.

Nina: Security/KMS note: Each envelope unwrap can add ~6-16ms depending on HSM. For POC we recommend KMS-proxy + local unwrap caching (TTL 45s) to avoid spikes. Need signed KMS addendum and CMK ARN from customer before we request keys. We'll enable 100% audit sampling for unwrap events.

Sasha: Great. @Priya schedule for 08:15 PT and tag run "sunburst-poc-6209876543". @Diego please drop the ops JSON and confirm KMS-proxy is ready. @Alex and @Nina please post quick one-line fallbacks and the KMS checklist by EOD.

bench-bot: Run queued by Priya  id: br-6209876543, start_time: 2026-06-20T15:15:00Z, phases: smoke/ramp/soak/cooldown.

Priya: Harness queued and smoke validated. Will enable tracing headers and collect flamegraphs; will post a concise results thread after soak with p50/p95/p99 and two ops actions.

Diego: KMS-proxy provisioned in POC VPC; will DM CMK instructions to customer once addendum signed.

Sasha: Thanks team :thumbsup:
